problem: Independent ROUND_HALF_UP rounding of each share replaces largest-remainder allocation, so shares no longer sum to amount (100 split 1:1:1 gives 99.99; 0.05 split 1:1 gives 0.06) and the lowest-index tie-break is lost.
_ref.allocate calls list(weights), which exhausts a generator or iterator, so line 20 sees no weights and allocate silently returns [] instead of the allocation.
The result of _ref.allocate is discarded, so every call computes the allocation twice, and validation depends on a duplicate reference_impl module that can drift from this one.
Decimal arithmetic in the default 28-digit context replaces exact Fraction math, so large or high-precision inputs can round or make quantize raise an uncaught InvalidOperation.
Decimal is imported twice, and Fraction and _to_decimal are now unused.
